# Historical test fixtures

These six YAML files are exact copies of the retired configurations from commit
fac2347c065a31f6775a92d9712680ad3580abb4. They support existing format-1/2,
precision, DDP and resume regression tests after production configs were removed.
They are test data, not new server recipes, and must not be used to start training.
Current production configurations and old experiment outputs are not modified.
